Read the following passage carefully and then answer the questions that follow. Citizenship goes with rights and duties. A citizen who knows well his/her rights and duties is a responsible citizen. The main duties of a citizen are loyalty to the country, obedience to laws, paying taxes and defend his/her country. As for loyalty, every citizen should be loyal and should not do anything that may disgrace his/her country. In addition, one should always think and work for the interests of the country. Responsible citizen should obey the laws of the country which are passed by the institutions of the country from time to time. Laws are necessary for the welfare of all. Obedience of the laws will ensure that there is 6 Find this and other free resources at: http://maktaba.tetea.org peace and order.
